description: Source code for the Renesas R8A779F0 Clock Pulse Generator / Module Standby and Software Reset driver in Zephyr RTOS, including configuration structures, clock control functions, and device initialization macros.

methods.name: r8a779f0_cpg_enable_disable_core
methods.description: Stub function to enable or disable core clocks, currently not supported.

methods.name: r8a779f0_cpg_core_clock_endisable
methods.description: Enables or disables core clock based on the provided clock info and enable flag.

methods.name: r8a779f0_cpg_mssr_start_stop
methods.description: Starts or stops the clock subsystem based on the enable flag.

methods.name: r8a779f0_cpg_mssr_start
methods.description: Wrapper to start the clock subsystem.

methods.name: r8a779f0_cpg_mssr_stop
methods.description: Wrapper to stop the clock subsystem.

methods.name: r8a779f0_cpg_mssr_init
methods.description: Initializes the clock control device, maps MMIO, and builds clock relationships.

methods.name: r8a779f0_get_div_helper
methods.description: Helper to get divider value for specific modules.

methods.name: r8a779f0_set_rate_helper
methods.description: Stub for setting clock rate, currently not supported.
